defs.def: on or to the further side of sth 在（或向）… 较远的一边

ex.s: Beyond visitor interaction, AI plays a crucial role in preserving priceless artworks.
ex.t: 除了访客互动，人工智能在保护无价艺术品方面也发挥着关键作用。

ex.s: Prof Gracie, with all his patience, asked me to think about it beyond whether I liked it or not.
ex.t: 格雷西教授以他全部的耐心，让我去想它，别只管我喜欢不喜欢。

ex.s: She adds that the program’s benefits go beyond nutrition.
ex.t: 她补充说，这个项目的好处不止于营养。

ex.s: They pulled the sausage beyond the dog’s reach.
ex.t: 他们把香肠拉到狗够不到的地方。

ex.s: But we want to go beyond one man and explore the nature of genius itself.
ex.t: 但我们想超越某一个人，去探索天才本身的本质。

ex.s: Then one perfect Amazonian evening, with monkeys calling from beyond the village green, we played soccer.
ex.t: 后来在一个完美的亚马孙夜晚，村庄绿地那头猴子鸣叫，我们踢起了足球。

ex.s: A child born in the US today has   63   very realistic chance of living beyond 100 and needs to plan accordingly.
ex.t: 今天在美国出生的孩子有___63___非常现实的机会活过100岁，因此需要相应地规划。

ex.s: in the shape of     B. beyond the reach of
ex.t: 形状为B. 无法达到

ex.s: I managed to get an A in that   53  and learned life lessons that have served me well beyond the  54  .
ex.t: 我设法在那门___53___拿了A，学到的生活道理在我毕业后也一直受用。

ex.s: Today, on an island in the Pacific, a specific type of shell still serves as currency — and some people there are even hoarding it, just like Bitcoin moguls, convinced that one day, it will make them wealthy beyond imagination.
ex.t: 今天，在太平洋的一个岛屿上，一种特定的贝壳仍然作为货币使用——有些人甚至囤积它，就像比特币模具一样，相信有一天，它将使他们变得富有，超越想象。

ex.s: under my noseD. beyond my wildest dreams
ex.t: 他们甚至能分辨出母亲的声音和陌生女性的声音。

ex.s: So they have a ＂God’s eye view＂ of activities in their own markets and beyond.
ex.t: 所以它们在自己市场及以外的活动中拥有"上帝视角"。

ex.s: Beyond that the colours darkened into fine shades of deep blue, and gradually disappeared.
ex.t: 再往远处，颜色逐渐变深，呈现出深蓝色的细腻渐变，然后渐渐消失了。

ex.s: The Fable of the Chicken Some stories have universal appeal: they go beyond the boundaries of individual countries and cultures.
ex.t: 鸡的寓言有些故事具有普遍的吸引力：它们超越了个别国家和文化的界限。

ex.s: Countless readers have been encouraged by Robinson Crusoe’s qualities, which go beyond his survival on a desert island.
ex.t: 无数读者被鲁滨逊·克鲁索的品质所鼓舞，这些品质超越了他在荒岛上的生存本身。

ex.s: More new chat benches have sprung up across the UK and beyond.
ex.t: 更多新的聊天长椅已在英国及更远的地方涌现。

ex.s: In artists’ representations of books and reading, we see moments of shared humanity that go beyond culture and time.
ex.t: 在艺术家对书籍和阅读的描绘中，我们看到了超越文化与时代的、人类共有的瞬间。

defs.def: later than a particular time 晚于；迟于
more than sth 超出；除 … 之外

ex.s: 36   Working out in the morning provides additional benefits beyond being physically fit.
ex.t: 36____早晨锻炼除了身体健康外还有额外的好处。

ex.s: The couple has a high   51   rate in getting accepted as house sitters and they always go beyond the homeowner's   52  .
ex.t: 这对夫妇被接受为房屋看护者的   51  率很高，他们总是超越房主的   52  。

ex.s: It goes beyond human imagination.
ex.t: 它超出了人类的想象范围。

ex.s: created a large number of works beyond his expectations
ex.t: 创作了大量超出他预期的作品

ex.s: He performed beyond everyone's expectations with his accurate shooting and continuous efforts.
ex.t: 他凭借精准的投篮和持续的努力，打出了超出所有人预期的表现。

ex.s: More researchers, policymakers and representatives from the food industry must learn to look beyond their direct lines of responsibility and adopt a systems approach.
ex.t: 更多研究者、政策制定者和食品行业代表必须学会超越其直接责任范围，并采用系统方法。

ex.s: Within the next 80 years, our lives may be changed beyond recognition by 3D printing.
ex.t: 在未来80年内，3D打印可能会让我们的生活发生翻天覆地的变化。

ex.s: While many species’ thought processes are limited to “Food, eat it!”, “Danger, run!”, “Pain, avoid!”, we’ve evolved beyond that.
ex.t: 许多物种的思维仅限于“食物，吃掉！”“危险，快跑！”“疼痛，避开！”，而我们已进化得超越这些。

defs.def: too far or too advanced for sb/sth 超出 … 之外；非 … 所能及

ex.s: Many people now misunderstand emotional intelligence as almost everything desirable in a person's makeup that cannot be measured by an IQ test, such as character, motivation, confidence, mental stability, optimism and "people skills." Research has shown that emotional skills may contribute to some of these qualities, but most of them move far beyond skill-based emotional intelligence.
ex.t: 现在许多人把情商误解为一个人特质中几乎所有无法用智商测试衡量的可取之处，比如性格、动力、自信、心理稳定、乐观和“人际技巧”。研究表明，情绪技能可能有助于其中一些品质，但大多数远远超出了基于技能的情商。
